methodology.counts: Lexical, nested comments and strings removed; anchored declaration commands; no kernel/semantic claims. Physical lines include comments/blanks.
methodology.generated: Corpus except handwritten Basic.lean, AxiomPins, pure-import roots, explicit source-generation header; unmarked is presumed handwritten, may contain unmarked generated code. Chain/agreement name alone is not a generation marker.
methodology.imports: Direct syntactic edges, multiplicity preserved; incoming includes all tracked Lean modules. Not transitive closure.
methodology.line_ratio: Nonblank lexical command spans for theorem/lemma versus other declaration kinds; instance proofs counted under definition. Approximation, not proof-term size.
methodology.references: docs/audits/architecture.md section 3; reused committed timing, no Lean executed.
methodology.timing: Historical CPU sample: column 3 full, column 4 import-only, difference body. Denominator uses census revision lines, not proven identical timed source. No area-wide estimate or current benchmark.

scope: Solidity/**/*.lean (tracked committed blobs); repository totals include all tracked .lean
